        f['below']=sum(1 for b in bs if b!=(r,c) and not(b[1]+1<c or c+1<b[1]) and b[0]>r)
        f['y']=col
        alls.append(f)
keys=[k for k in alls[0] if k not in('demo','y')]

# pairs: (a op b) parity / equality combos
